ddl.audit_logs:
CREATE TABLE `audit_logs` (

  `actorUserId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `targetType` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `targetId` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `ipAddress` varchar(45) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,

ddl.cart_items:
CREATE TABLE `cart_items` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `cartId` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `productId` int NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `cart_items_cart_product_unique` (`cartId`,`productId`),
  KEY `cart_items_product_fk` (`productId`),
  CONSTRAINT `cart_items_cart_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`cartId`) REFERENCES `carts` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `cart_items_product_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `cart_items_quantity_positive` CHECK ((`quantity` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.carts:
CREATE TABLE `carts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `buyerId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `carts_buyer_unique` (`buyerId`),
  CONSTRAINT `carts_buyer_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`buyerId`) REFERENCES `buyers` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.categories:
CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(120) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `protected` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `categories_name_unique` (`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `categories_protected_valid` CHECK ((`protected` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.order_items:
CREATE TABLE `order_items` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `orderId` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `productId` int NOT NULL,
  `productTitle` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `quantity` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `unitPrice` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `order_items_order_fk` (`orderId`),
  KEY `order_items_product_fk` (`productId`),
  CONSTRAINT `order_items_order_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`orderId`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `order_items_product_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `order_items_quantity_positive` CHECK ((`quantity` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `order_items_unit_price_nonnegative` CHECK ((`unitPrice` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.order_status_history:
CREATE TABLE `order_status_history` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `orderId` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `previousStatus` enum('PENDING','PREPARING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','CANCELED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `newStatus` enum('PENDING','PREPARING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','CANCELED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `changedByUserId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `occurredAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `order_status_history_order_fk` (`orderId`),
  KEY `order_status_history_actor_fk` (`changedByUserId`),
  CONSTRAINT `order_status_history_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`changedByUserId`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `order_status_history_order_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`orderId`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.orders:
CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `buyerId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `sellerId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `checkoutId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('PENDING','PREPARING','SHIPPED','DELIVERED','CANCELED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `deliveryAddressSnapshot` json NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `orders_checkout_seller_unique` (`checkoutId`,`sellerId`),
  KEY `orders_buyer_fk` (`buyerId`),
  KEY `orders_seller_fk` (`sellerId`),
  CONSTRAINT `orders_buyer_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`buyerId`) REFERENCES `buyers` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `orders_seller_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`sellerId`) REFERENCES `sellers` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `orders_total_nonnegative` CHECK ((`total` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.product_categories:
CREATE TABLE `product_categories` (
  `categoryId` int NOT NULL,
  `productId` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`productId`,`categoryId`),
  KEY `product_categories_category_restrict_fk` (`categoryId`),
  CONSTRAINT `product_categories_category_restrict_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`categoryId`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `product_categories_product_restrict_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`productId`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.products:
CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `sellerId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `stock` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `imagePublicId` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `products_seller_fk` (`sellerId`),
  CONSTRAINT `products_seller_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`sellerId`) REFERENCES `sellers` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `products_price_nonnegative` CHECK ((`price` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.sellers:
CREATE TABLE `sellers` (
  `userId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `storeName` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED','SUSPENDED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `requestedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `reviewedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewedByUserId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `rejectionReason` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`userId`),
  KEY `sellers_reviewer_fk` (`reviewedByUserId`),
  CONSTRAINT `sellers_reviewer_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewedByUserId`) REFERENCES `admins` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `sellers_user_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`userId`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.user_addresses:
CREATE TABLE `user_addresses` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `buyerId` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(40) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipientName` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `street` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `exteriorNumber` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `interiorNumber` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `neighborhood` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `city` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `postalCode` varchar(12) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `country` char(2) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MX',
  `isDefault` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_addresses_one_active_default` (((case when ((`isDefault` = 1) and (`deletedAt` is null)) then `buyerId` else NULL end))),
  KEY `user_addresses_buyer_fk` (`buyerId`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_addresses_buyer_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`buyerId`) REFERENCES `buyers` (`userId`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `user_addresses_default_valid` CHECK ((`isDefault` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.users:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(254) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `passwordHash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(120) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `phoneNumber` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DISABLED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `emailVerifiedAt` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deletedAt` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
